description: This file defines the NoteRequest class used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for creating or updating notes via API requests in a notes application backend.

classes.name: NoteRequest
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing the payload for creating or updating a note, including title and content fields.

methods.name: NoteRequest(String title, String content)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize NoteRequest with a title and content.

methods.name: setTitle(String title)
methods.description: Sets the note's title and returns the NoteRequest object for chaining.

methods.name: setContent(String content)
methods.description: Sets the note's content and returns the NoteRequest object for chaining.
